fact: Radio Tamazuj reports that the draft bill, when passed, will establish a Data Protection Commission to safeguard the personal data of South Sudanese online users.
The factsheet states no data protection authority has been appointed and the country has no law establishing one, as of 24 May 2022 (published date used).

Digital Rights Frontlines states South Sudan currently lacks a fully operational, independent Data Protection Authority, and that the government intends to introduce a Data Protection Bill; no date given for the statement, so the document's published date is used.
The East African Community says South Sudan is yet to form a data protection authority.
